The '''Morvogodine stormtrooper training facility''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] training facility located on Morvogodine, headed by the infamous stormtrooper commander [[Kayn Somos/Legends|Kayn Somos]]. The facility was notorious for being extremely vicious, even by stormtrooper training facility standards. Often, its students are sent by Somos on "peacekeeping" missions as a final test of whether they had the means of becoming part of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].
